reactor_type: customized thermal ALD chamber (ICOT Company Inc.)
evidence: The ALD was performed at a temperature range of 200–250°C, and the TDMASn and TMPO sources were evaporated at 40°C and room temperature, respectively. The pulse durations of both precursors were set to 1 s, while the H2O and ozone were supplied at pulse durations of 1 and 3 s, respectively. Dry nitrogen (99.999%) was used as the transport and purge gas with a flow rate of 1.5 sccm, with a purging time of 15 s and a chamber pressure maintained at 0.2 Torr.
